steps.title: Define App Metadata
steps.description: Create the app-meta.json file defining the app name and custom package identifier.

steps.title: Configure Build Environment
steps.description: Configure compile parameters targeting SDK 34 and Java 8 compatibility inside build.gradle.

steps.title: Create Android Manifest File
steps.description: Initialize manifest declaring permissions, primary launcher activity, and layout indicators using exact XML namespaces.

steps.title: Configure Colors Asset Profile
steps.description: Design dynamic color palette defining modern shades for savings balances, transactions, and categories.

steps.title: Declare App Visual Themes
steps.description: Establish basic Light Theme metrics to support uniform layouts across device versions without material design components.

steps.title: Formulate Rounded Card Backgrounds
steps.description: Build XML shapes representing general cards, positive earnings containers, and negative cost widgets.

steps.title: Create Input State Drawables
steps.description: Generate drawable files representing custom buttons, active selector forms, and indicator structures.

steps.title: Design Transaction Layout Template
steps.description: Develop visual structure for individual transaction ledger rows featuring color indicators and removal switches.

steps.title: Design Category Analysis Component Layout
steps.description: Establish modular bar chart interface utilizing dynamically-tinted native ProgressBars to outline category spending ratios.

steps.title: Design Core Transaction Model Class
steps.description: Create a data model class encapsulating identifiers, transaction types, categorization strings, and cost parameters.

steps.title: Establish Storage Database Wrapper
steps.description: Code the SQL database helper engine defining queries to insert, erase, and fetch transactions filtered by calendar month.

steps.title: Design Multi-Panel Main Layout
steps.description: Assemble primary framework with navigation components, summary meters, income registration panels, and reports panels.

steps.title: Code Activity Controller Logic
steps.description: Implement MainActivity binder establishing tab events, verification triggers, database pipelines, and dynamic analytics updates.

steps.title: Building Expense Tracker
steps.description: Execute gradle script to compile resources and execute packaging into a debuggable application package.
